messages.content: You identify patterns in complete email texts. Respond with valid JSON.

Please write a BRIEF 15-20 word executive summary of the theme "Email and Cloud Services" as it appears in the following examples.
['Under quot;Know your Customer (KYC)quot; ordinance Apple is mandated by guidelines to carry out a verification of your information, omission to do so will result in termination of your Apple ID within the next three days.', 'Help-desk is currently Migrating your Outlook account to Microsoft Exchange 2014.', 'You have used 98.9% of the total data allocated to your mailbox.', 'Please review these and sign electronically using the DocuSign prompts.', 'There are 23 new messages in your Email Quarantine since you received your last Notification.', 'Security Notice Your Apple ID has been locked to protect your personal information.', 'we are upgrading and expanding all staff mailbox immediately.', 'Under "Know your Customer (KYC)" ordinance Apple is required by guidelines to effectuate a verification of your information, failure to do so will conclude in termination of your Apple ID within the next three days.', 'Our records indicate you are no longer our current email user.', 'Your account is still open for you to send and receive e-mail.', 'You have new messages for your Cornell account.', 'Facebook sent you a message.', 'Thanks, The AOL Mail Team', 'This is the last notice to inform you as of 12 - Sep - 2016 that you have not yet updated your iCloud ID information.', 'click on the link below to Set Up Mobile Alert for your webmail account.', 'Your Email Account security is weak and can easily be hacked.', 'We noticed your account is open in one other location with network IP address (200.1.27.75)', 'Your email has used up the storage limit of 99.9 gigabytes as defined by your Administrator.', 'BT is pleased to announce the launch of New Webmail Interface!.', 'Your Arnold account has been placed on temporary block, it would be permanently blocked if you do not unblock within 48hours.', 'Click the Link below to re-validate your mailbox.', 'Thanks for using Earthlink']

DO NOT write the summary as a third party using terms like "the text examples" or "they discuss", but write the summary from the perspective of the text authors making the points directly.
Please respond ONLY with a valid JSON in the following format:
{
    "summary": "<SUMMARY>"
}
